_about: Oria insights panels (includes/facet-insights.php): figures Oria Haven worked out from details checked on each venue's own website or the booking page it links to. Keyed by facet URL slug. 'checked' is the date of the check; panels older than 183 days are hidden, so re-check and bump the date. 'snapshot' replaces the hero's 'Typical published price' on that page. Never fill a figure from a listing's generic price_from. Source research for the sauna panels: D:/OriaHaven/drafts/saunas/sauna-prices-checked-2026-10-07.json.

_method.typical: Median of single-person, sauna-only prices for that session length, one price per venue. Pods and multi-therapy rooms (Element, Active Wellness) and sauna-plus-ice-bath bundles excluded.
_method.cheapest_for_two: Lowest published two-person price for the shortest common session.
_method.river: North or south of the Swan River by the venue's suburb.
_method.private: Venues whose own site says sessions are private or the cabin is your own; 'not stated' is not counted either way.
_method.lengths: Count of venues offering each session length, out of venues with a working website.
